subject: Risk-explanation status: reproduction done, explanation stability is the real question
body:
Hi Dmitri, Jelena,

Status.

Reproduction landed Apr 15: the observation-sequence model trains cleanly on the reference in_hospital_death task (20k train steps as in the example config), AUC within 0.4 points of our expected band, and the explanation weights over input observations look sensible on spot checks - dense_sequence_feature attributions concentrate on the harmonized observation values you'd clinically expect.

The deeper issue for the May 22 clinical review: explanation stability. When we retrain with a different seed, the risk predictions barely move but the attribution weights shift noticeably - top-3 attributed observations overlap only ~70% across seeds. Clinicians will (rightly) ask why the same patient gets different explanations from "the same" model.

Plan: Gustavo is adding an ensemble-attribution mode (average weights over 5 seeds), which lifts top-3 overlap to 91% in early tests at 5x explanation-time cost. Explanation latency isn't clinical-loop critical, so I think that trade is right. Review packet will show both modes.

Vera
